name: agent-watch
description: Keeps the number of running Claude Code sessions under a limit and shows the ones waiting on you or sitting idle.

limit.title: Session limit
limit.description: How many sessions may be working or waiting before Agent Watch warns you.

idleMinutes.title: Forgotten after (minutes)
idleMinutes.description: Toast when another session has been idle or waiting on you this long.

strict.title: Strict mode
strict.description: Hold a prompt at the limit until you press Enter again to confirm.

countSubagents.title: Count subagents
countSubagents.description: Also count this session's running background subagents toward the limit.

name.title: Your name
name.description: The name the warning greets you with; empty uses $USER.
